projects.title: Enterprise Resource Planning System
projects.shortDescription: Cloud ERP unifying manufacturing ops — inventory, HR, finance & analytics.
projects.detailedDescription: A complete ERP system that integrates every facet of a manufacturing operation — from inventory to HR — into a single cohesive platform with real-time analytics and automated workflows.
projects.challenge: Siloed data across departments led to inefficiencies, communication gaps, and costly errors in production and inventory.
projects.solution: A custom cloud-based ERP with modular architecture: real-time inventory tracking, CRM, HR portal, finance automation, and a central analytics dashboard with role-based access.

impact.label: Increase in Operational Efficiency
impact.subtext: Measured across all departments within 6 months

projects.results: 40% increase in operational efficiency across all departments

projects.title: Test Series Desktop App
projects.shortDescription: Offline-first Windows app for competitive exam preparation with real-time analytics.
projects.detailedDescription: A secure, offline-first desktop app that lets students take timed mock tests, review performance with detailed analytics, and access a large question bank without a constant internet connection.
projects.challenge: Students in areas with poor connectivity needed a reliable, fast platform to practice — existing web solutions were inaccessible and slow.
projects.solution: A native WPF application storing data locally, with a secure test environment, instant scoring, question-wise reports, and an online sync to fetch new tests and upload results.

impact.label: Students Using the App
impact.subtext: 92% satisfaction rate across all user surveys

projects.results: Used by 10k+ students with 92% satisfaction rate

projects.title: GTS Car Rental App
projects.shortDescription: Ola/Uber-style ride-hailing app with real-time GPS, in-app payments & ratings.
projects.detailedDescription: A comprehensive ride-hailing app for iOS and Android connecting passengers with drivers — real-time GPS tracking, in-app payments, scheduling, and two-way rating.
projects.challenge: The client wanted to enter a competitive ride-sharing market with a reliable platform offering a superior regional experience.
projects.solution: Native passenger and driver apps with a powerful booking backend, Google Maps navigation, Stripe payments, and real-time chat between rider and driver.

impact.label: Play Store Downloads
impact.subtext: Tripled user base within the first 3 months

projects.results: Tripled user base within 3 months | 60,000+ Play Store downloads

testimonial.quote: Brolytics delivered exactly what we envisioned — our app outperforms competitors on both speed and UX.
testimonial.name: Rohan Mehta

projects.title: Golobolosys Fashion Website
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered luxury fashion e-commerce with smart recommendations and virtual try-on.
projects.detailedDescription: A high-end e-commerce platform for a luxury fashion brand with an AI recommendation engine, virtual try-on, and a visually rich, seamless shopping experience.
projects.challenge: The brand needed an online presence matching its luxury status and a personalized experience to lift engagement and conversion.
projects.solution: A headless store on Next.js + Shopify with a custom AI model for personalized recommendations and an AR.js virtual try-on feature.

impact.label: Increase in Conversion Rate
impact.subtext: Compared to previous website within 2 months

projects.title: Rainbow Game App
projects.shortDescription: Addictive cross-platform puzzle game with procedural levels and global leaderboards.
projects.detailedDescription: An addictive puzzle game for iOS and Android with procedurally generated levels, vibrant graphics, intuitive controls, and global leaderboards.
projects.challenge: In a saturated gaming market, the client wanted a simple yet engaging game that stands out visually with high replayability.
projects.solution: Built in Unity for cross-platform release, with procedural level generation, Game Center / Play Games leaderboards, and AdMob rewarded-ad monetization.
projects.results: Featured on Play Store | 4.8 star rating with 25k+ reviews

projects.title: AI-Powered ERP Software
projects.shortDescription: AI-driven ERP with sales forecasting, automated workflows, and unified dashboards.
projects.detailedDescription: A bespoke ERP for a mid-sized enterprise that automates and integrates core business functions with AI-driven forecasting and an automated workflow engine.
projects.challenge: Disconnected tools caused data redundancy and no unified view of operations, hampering strategic planning.
projects.solution: A web ERP on Laravel + Vue.js with a Python AI module for sales forecasting, role-based dashboards, automated reports, and scalable Docker deployment.

impact.label: Man-Hours Saved Per Year
impact.subtext: Through automated workflows and AI-driven decisions

projects.title: Global Brand Campaign
projects.shortDescription: Multi-channel B2B SaaS launch strategy across SEO, PPC, content and influencer marketing.
projects.detailedDescription: A comprehensive campaign for a B2B SaaS launch spanning SEO, content, PPC, and social to establish market presence and a qualified lead pipeline.
projects.challenge: Launching in a competitive market, the client needed to quickly build brand awareness and generate high-quality leads from day one.
projects.solution: A multi-pronged strategy: technical SEO, content marketing, targeted Google & LinkedIn ads, influencer outreach, and HubSpot lead nurturing flows.

impact.label: Increase in Qualified Leads
impact.subtext: Achieved within the first 3 months of campaign launch

projects.title: Corporate Rebranding
projects.shortDescription: Full visual identity overhaul — logo, brand guidelines, website, and all collateral.
projects.detailedDescription: A full rebrand to modernize an established financial firm — new logo, brand guidelines, website design, and a complete set of marketing collateral.
projects.challenge: An outdated identity failed to resonate with a new generation of investors; they needed a fresh, trustworthy look.
projects.solution: Market research and brand workshops defined the strategy; we delivered a new identity, comprehensive brand book, redesigned site, and print/digital collateral.

impact.label: Increase in Brand Recognition
impact.subtext: Based on post-launch market survey across target audience
